fee_notes: Royalty (License Fee) is tiered 3–6.5% of Gross Sales (excluding 'roll-in' sales); minimum license fees apply per a Fees Chart. Certain existing franchisees may maintain preexisting license fee rates at renewal. MAP Contribution is currently 2% of Gross Sales per week per franchise agreement. Local Marketing Requirement is $1 per territory home (TH) per year, declining to a minimum of $0.15 per TH if criteria are met. Local Marketing Groups (LMGs) contributions not to exceed 3% of Gross Sales. Tech fee is $155.45/month for the Technology Package; additional email accounts cost $19–$30/month each; additional Franchise Portal User Accounts $20–$40/month; QuickBooks Online through ZorWare adds $30–$220/month depending on license tier. Late fee on Software System Fees is $25/month or legal maximum. Call Center Services Fees are $250–$449.99/month plus $25–$40 per booked appointment.
raw_excerpt:
License Fee (Note 1): 3 – 6 ½ % of Gross Sales except for "roll-in" sales. In addition, minimum license fees apply. Due by automatic debit each Monday (Note 3).

MAP Contribution (Note 4): The then-current fee (currently 2% of Gross Sales per week per Molly Maid franchise agreement that you have entered into with us). Due by automatic debit each Monday (Note 4).

Local Marketing Requirement (Note 5): $1 per TH per year, which declines as Gross Sales increase, to a minimum of $0.15 per TH if criteria are met. Payable per supplier's terms.

Local Marketing Groups1, 2, 3: Not to exceed 3% of Gross Sales. Determined by LMG members.

Software System Fees (Note 6): Currently $155.45 per month for the Technology Package. For any additional email accounts (above the two included): $19 per month for each additional E1 email account, $30 per month for each additional E3 email account, or $5.50 per month for each additional exchange email account. Additional Franchise Portal User Accounts are available at $20 - $40/month. If you obtain QuickBooks Online through ZorWare, you will pay an additional fee of $30-$220 per month depending on the license tier that you select. Paid monthly via automatic bank draft.

Late Fees (on Software System Fees): $25 per month or the maximum amount allowed under the law, whichever is less. As incurred.

Call Center Services Fees (Note 1): $250.00- $449.99/month plus $25- $40 per booked appointment based on the number of appointments booked, with the per appointment fee decreasing based on number of booked. Paid monthly in arrears.
